title: [a11y]: Improve screen reader navigation for course sequence tabs
author: PKulkoRaccoonGang
body_preview: ## Description  The course sequence tabs do not provide sufficient information to enable a person using a screen reader to effectively navigate course content. author: PKulkoRaccoonGang
body_preview: ## Description  The Course navigation and breadcrumb regions should not be nested under the main region of the page. title: [a11y]: Missing heading markup in Course Overview accordions impacts screen reader usability
author: PKulkoRaccoonGang
body_preview: ## Description  The show/hide accordions on the Course Overview screen lack markup which can significantly enhance the user experience for students who use a screen reader.  Specifically, accordions are not marked up as headings to enable quick navigation.
